swap_risks: CAUTION PACKAGE HEIGHT/PROFILE: AP62300WU-7 (TSOT-23-6) vs TPS54302DDCR (SOT-23-6) share the same JEDEC land pattern pitch, but thin-profile TSOT (~1.0 mm) vs standard SOT (~1.45 mm) differs in body height; verify enclosure Z-clearance, SMT nozzle height, and solder fillet spec.
CRITICAL SWITCH-VOLTAGE OVERSTRESS RISK: AP62300WU-7 is rated up to only 7 V output (p.4) vs TPS54302DDCR up to 28 V (p.12); exceeding the internal switch BVdss ceiling destroys the SW MOSFET.
HIGH MINIMUM OUTPUT VOLTAGE FLOOR: AP62300WU-7 cannot regulate below 0.8 V (p.4) vs TPS54302DDCR down to 0.596 V (p.5); verify your target rail sits above the higher Vout,min floor.
HIGH VREF MISMATCH: Feedback reference differs (AP62300WU-7: 0.8 V p.5 vs TPS54302DDCR: 0.596 V p.5); dropping in without recalculating R1/R2 will output the wrong voltage rail.

HIGH SWITCHING FREQUENCY SHIFT: fsw differs by 47% (AP62300WU-7: 750 kHz p.5 vs TPS54302DDCR: 400 kHz p.5); re-evaluate inductor core loss, ripple current ΔIL, output capacitor ESR ripple, and EMI harmonics.
CAUTION INDUCTOR RETUNING: Typical inductor differs (AP62300WU-7: 3.3 µH p.17 vs TPS54302DDCR: 10 µH p.18); check inductor Isat against peak switch current limit.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RANGE SHIFT: Recommended Vin,max differs (AP62300WU-7: 18 V p.4 vs TPS54302DDCR: 28 V p.4); verify line transients stay below Vin,abs,max.
HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: AP62300WU-7 has a lower Vin,abs,max rating (20 V, p.4) than TPS54302DDCR (30 V, p.4); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 20 V.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 70% higher on TPS54302DDCR (AP62300WU-7: 70 °C/W p.4 vs TPS54302DDCR: 118.9 °C/W p.4); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (AP62300WU-7: -40..85 °C Industrial (-40°C to +85°C TA; -40°C to +125°C TJ) vs TPS54302DDCR: -40..125 °C Industrial / Extended (-40°C to 125°C TJ)); AP62300WU-7 hot limit only 85 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: AP62300WU-7 (Diodes Incorporated, TSOT-23-6) and TPS54302DDCR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-6) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because package code differs (TSOT-23-6 vs SOT-23-6; same land pattern, different body profile); adjustable Vout,max ceiling drops >=20% (7 V vs 28 V — switch-voltage overstress risk); minimum programmable Vout,min rises (0.596 V vs 0.8 V). Power-stage deltas: buck (sync) vs buck (sync), switching frequency 750 kHz (p.5) vs 400 kHz (p.5) (1.9x ratio), typical inductor 3.3 µH (p.17) vs 10 µH (p.18), feedback Vref 0.8 V (p.5) vs 0.596 V (p.5), and package θJA 70 vs 118.9 °C/W. Primary bench gotchas to watch: AP62300WU-7 "CRITICAL: Pin 5 (EN) Abs Max Is ONLY 8.0 V — Direct 12 V VIN Tie Destroys AP62300WU-7" (p.4) and TPS54302DDCR "CRITICAL: EN Pin Abs Max Is ONLY 7.0 V (Rec 5.5 V) — NEVER Tie Directly to 12 V / 24 V VIN" (p.4). BOM decision: Choose AP62300WU-7 when matching your existing Diodes Incorporated TSOT-23-6 (TSOT26 (WU)) qualification and -40..85 °C grade; choose TPS54302DDCR when bus voltage exceeds 18 V (rated to 28 V) or programmed output rails exceed 7 V (up to 28 V). Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
